login_background.description: White and blue container ship on sea during daytime - to be used for the right half of the login screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI components but override their default rounded corners to rounded-sm or rounded-none for a sharper corporate look. Avoid any massive drop-shadows or gradients.
Use Lucide-react for icons. Size them appropriately (w-4 h-4 in buttons, w-5 h-5 in sidebar).
For the dashboard, strictly follow the SaaSFrame 2026 pattern: Important KPI top left, progressive disclosure, clean flat tables.
Invoice creation page MUST support multi-currency dynamically. Use a clean dense form layout for line items. Ensure currency symbols update based on selection.
Ensure ALL interactive and key informational elements have `data-testid` attributes using kebab-case role-based names (e.g., `data-testid="create-invoice-button"`).
The sidebar navigation should be dark (bg-slate-900) to anchor the UI and align with the deep navy maritime logo. The active item should have an amber left border.
The print/PDF layout MUST strictly resemble a professional B2B Excel invoice. Use strict borders, precise tabular-nums, and exact structure defined in `screens.invoice_print`.
All monetary amounts must use the `tabular-nums` utility class so decimals align vertically in tables.
Add the Google Fonts (Chivo and IBM Plex Sans) directly to index.html and configure them in tailwind.config.js.
